items.summary_zh: 智谱人工智能创始人唐杰19日在X平台发文，系统阐述其对Scaling Law的最新理解，并以GLM-5.3作为"控制变量实验"佐证这一判断

items.title: Unitree shares surge in a memorable IPO scene: Wang Xingxing looks utterly calm, like an ordinary working person; his upper-tier partnership stake in Shanghai Yuyi will all go to employee incentives

items.title: Treasury yields are closing in on 5%, yet U.S. stocks have risen 80%
items.title_zh: 美债逼近5%，美股反而涨了80%
items.summary: Veteran U.S. equity traders Dan Nathan and Guy Adami break down the underlying logic: the last time Treasury yields hit 5%, the S&P 500 stood at only 4,200; now, with the United States carrying 40 trillion dollars of debt, the index has forced its way up to 7,700.
items.summary_zh: 美股资深交易员 Dan Nathan 和 Guy Adami 拆解了背后的底层逻辑： 上一次美债收益率冲到 5% 时，标普 500 只有 4200 点； 如今美国背着 40 万亿巨额债务，大盘却强行飙到了 7700 点

items.title: AI compute being this profitable right now is precisely the most dangerous moment
items.title_zh: 现在AI算力这么赚钱，恰恰是最危险的时刻
items.summary: Well-known tech business strategy analyst Ben Thompson draws analogies with shipping and memory cycles, arguing that windfall profits in AI compute are inducing simultaneous capacity expansion.
items.summary_zh: 知名科技商业战略分析师Ben Thompson以航运、内存周期类比，指出AI算力暴利正诱发同步扩产

items.title: Zelenskyy faces challenge to his wartime rule as former defense chief calls for election

items.title: A-share indexes close lower across the board as Unitree soars 460% on its trading debut

items.summary_zh: A股三大指数今日集体走弱，截止收盘，沪指跌2.40%，收报3894.42点；深证成指跌5.01%，收报13890.15点；创业板指跌6.26%，收报3473.49点

items.title: Goldman Sachs on how to understand the current wave of AI investment
items.title_zh: 高盛解读：如何理解当前的AI投资？
items.summary: Goldman Sachs executives Sharmin Mossavar-Rahmani and Jim Covello note that consumer adoption of AI is fast but 95% of users stay on free tiers and cannot be monetized, while enterprises spend heavily on AI implementation without making money, leaving almost all of the economic value with semiconductor companies, which is unsustainable.
items.summary_zh: 高盛高管Sharmin Mossavar-Rahmani和Jim Covello指出，AI消费端采用快，但95%用户用免费版，无法变现；企业端砸钱实施AI却未赚钱，经济价值几乎全归半导体公司，不可持续

items.summary_zh: 高盛发现，AI 已开始对发达经济体的就业形成压力。
